h: Tinubu's full campaign flag-off speech published after APC's Kaduna launch
p: The text of President Tinubu's remarks at the APC 2027 presidential campaign flag-off has been published. He used the Kaduna event to defend his record and appeal to voters ahead of the 2027 polls. Reaction from opposition parties has continued to follow.
more: The speech followed his remarks accusing opponents of exploiting hunger.
The ADC and NDC camps have already answered parts of it.
Port Harcourt is the next stop on the campaign timetable.
